_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 31: late November 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord grieving and saying America has turned its back on him, that many of them have, but that there is a remnant who have not.
mentions.quote: America, you have turned your back upon me. Many of them. There's a remnant
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a verdict on a nation's spiritual state.

mentions.claim_text: He says plainly that if someone kicks in his door and comes in to hurt him they will not be there the next day and will go home early, and that he will pray for them afterwards.
mentions.quote: You kick in my door, you're not going to be here
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement about self defence, not a prediction.

mentions.claim_text: He says 1 Corinthians 5:5 is the scripture given him for 2026, and that there will be political theatre and drama with calls to impeach again and the judges rising up.
mentions.quote: first Corinthians 5:5 is about 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Impeachment proceedings and judicial conflict through 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says what Jesus said on 17 January is starting to come to pass, pointing at the rain, and recalls the bamboo from that night with the Lord.
mentions.quote: the thing that Jesus said on January 17th is coming starting to come to pass
mentions.falsify_match: A 17 January 2025 statement locatable in the corpus, with the rain and bamboo in it.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that there is not enough urgency in the body of Christ, and that if they truly believed he was coming there would be more.
mentions.quote: If you truly believe it, there would be more urgency
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the same word he says was given forty one years ago.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats 1 Corinthians 5:5 and says many people will see this in 2026.
mentions.quote: Many people will see this in 2026. 1 Corinthians 5:5
mentions.falsify_match: Public cases of people handed over for destruction of the flesh so the spirit may be saved.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though the criterion is inherently interpretive.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that in 2026 they are able to get the legislation done for the glorious outpouring, saying that is what is happening right now and that he means the manifestations of the finances.
mentions.quote: 2026, that we're able to get the legislation done
mentions.falsify_match: Crypto market structure legislation passing in 2026 with a financial windfall following.

mentions.claim_text: He rests on the promise to be with them always, notes it did not say he had to act a certain way, and asks who ever said you were going to feel it.
mentions.quote: who said you were going to feel it?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the same structure as symptoms-do-not-count: absence of the experience is ruled out as evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He says celebrities with millions and a new Ferrari who are depressed and on Prozac are not prosperous, and discusses whether to come to California in January.
mentions.quote: they're depressed and they're on Prozac. That's not prosperous
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, plus travel plans.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees this happening in more ministries and that the Lord warns him specifically it will happen a lot in 2026, telling him they will see it and to pray for them.
mentions.quote: happen a lot in 2026. And he said, You will see this in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A run of ministry scandals through 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does prophesy over individuals and give words to people when told to, comparing it to the lady in the church, and begins to qualify that not everything he sees is for saying.
mentions.quote: I do I prophesy over individuals. I give words to people
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it belongs with the other reasons material stays unpublished.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something like Lego buildings built up where men were planning and strategising against the nation's capital, and says he keeps seeing this underground chatter and these secret meetings.
mentions.quote: they were planning and strategizing against our nation's capital
mentions.falsify_match: A plot against Washington DC uncovered.

mentions.claim_text: He says what they want to do with Israel they can do with these other areas, that as America goes so goes the world, and that America is the watchdog of the world.
mentions.quote: as America goes, so does the world
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a framing of American centrality.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a presidential address following a savage attack, thanking the United States military deployed at home and abroad, the Secret Service and the DC Metropolitan Police.
mentions.quote: down in a savage attack
mentions.falsify_match: A real attack in Washington DC, which he sets against the capital plot material.

mentions.claim_text: He says the harvest is coming to their doorstep and all hidden things will be revealed, that they may not get it on this side of the earth, but that they will burn in hell if they do not repent because judgment is coming.
mentions.quote: you're going to burn in hell if you don't repent
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and he says so: they may not get it on this side of the earth.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a day highlighted and circled and was told to pray over it, worked out that it is 13 April, Holocaust Remembrance Day, and calls it a very sad day while asking why that date.
mentions.quote: It's Holocaust Remembrance Day. And I thought, Why April 13th?
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event on 13 April 2026, Yom HaShoah.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge to someone unable to conceive whose marriage is near divorce over it, saying God is bringing healing to the bodies.
mentions.quote: you're willing to divorce because you can't conceive
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: a circumstance common enough that any large audience supplies a match.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Zelensky being strong-armed by Trump and looking over his shoulder to Macron asking what to do, because they wanted to keep the status quo.
mentions.quote: Zalinski was was being strongarmed by President Trump
mentions.falsify_match: American pressure on Ukraine to accept terms, with European leaders resisting.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are regrouping and licking their wounds but have plotted a plan, are furious about how Gaza went and feel they lost Palestine and other areas, and were devising a brutal attack in the days ahead worse than October 7th.
mentions.quote: devising a plan of a brutal attack in the days ahead. Worse than October 7
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on Israel exceeding 7 October 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them in Europe buying drones from somewhere like Amazon and attaching things to detonate them into crowds during tree lighting ceremonies, parades and New Year's Eve.
mentions.quote: attaching things to this to detonate them into crowds during treelighting ceremonies
mentions.time_phrase: tree lightings, parades, New Year's Eve
mentions.falsify_match: A drone attack on a European Christmas or New Year crowd.
mentions.falsify_miss: The season passes without one, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man must live long and finish strong because God has an assignment that will be seen even more in 2026 and 2027, and that they must pray over the midterms so they do not have a stalemate government.
mentions.quote: you will see that assignment even more in 2026 and 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A working majority after the midterms rather than deadlock.
mentions.falsify_miss: Deadlock, which stalemate-government-2026 says he saw.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be unusual cold fronts and Siberian air, anticipates the objection that winter always has those, and insists there will be unusual weather patterns and an unusual winter in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: there's going to be unusual weather patterns in the days ahead. an unusual winter
mentions.falsify_match: A winter of record cold outbreaks and unusual patterns.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary winter. He raises the objection himself and does not answer it.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the man would not turn into the snake he saw him turning into by 2028, would not backstab, would stay the course and be what he needs to be.
mentions.quote: would not turn to the snake that I saw him turning into by 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A senior political figure turning on the administration before 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and the man is not named here.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a major move of a red wave and an even greater revival starting over 2026, calling revival over America, Europe, South America, Asia and Africa.
mentions.quote: move of a red wave and it will be even more of a great revival
mentions.falsify_match: A Republican sweep and a global revival in 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is February and they have time, that this is about right now, and describes zooming in and out like a camera lens, able to go deep but needing to pull back and focus on where they are.
mentions.quote: it's like one of those camera lenses. I can go way way deep
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is another account of how he assigns dates: zooming a lens rather than being told.
